what_it_does: The grades a score adds up: P(2)+P(3), planned and committed.
What a sentence-level question sends: sentence (the sentence with its lead-in, section and component) or paragraph (the paragraph too). Changing it re-asks every sentence.
Items a request carries (0 = one a request; $WBG_ASK_BATCH overrides).
Characters a batched request may hold.
Characters one item's request may hold before its questions are split over several.
Starting gate for the asset map until the skip rule fits one: a sentence is asked an asset at this cosine to its phrases or above, or when a word pattern matches.
A sentence has an asset of its own at this posterior or above (read at publish).
What the asset map's feedback rounds count as a yes (in what is asked).
Paragraph rule: earlier sentences' asset scores summed, each multiplied by this per sentence back; 0 = off.
The decayed sum's own floor (level paragraph).
Every asset at the floor (true) or the best only (false).
Starting gate for a measure until the skip rule fits one.
Also ask a measure's best N sentences by cosine whatever their score; 0 = off.
Share of the graded yes a fitted gate may leave below it.
Graded yes a label needs before its gate is fitted.
Sentences a feedback round asks per label (assets and measures).
A round yielding fewer at the ask floor is the last.
Most feedback rounds for a measure; 0 = off.
Share of the rejected sentences' centroid subtracted from the query (Rocchio).
Most feedback rounds for an asset; 0 = off (the asset map's other round settings are the measures').
Apply the fitted probability layer to the scores (true) or decide on the raw score (false). The evaluation checks the layer out of fold either way.
How sharply similarity counts in the vote of graded sentences.
Also use similarity to the graded yes centroid minus the no centroid.
Fit each decision kind's labels together, one intercept each, shared slopes.
Precision of the normal prior on each standardised slope.
Fewer graded rows than this: no layer.
Fewer graded yes or no than this: no layer for the label.
Leave graded near-copies above this similarity out of the vote; off = only the sentence itself.
Folds (whole projects) for the out-of-fold check.
Fits weight each graded row by its design weight to this power: 0 = every row once; 1 = the reporting weights (which span 2 to 9,000).
A sentence counts for a measure at this posterior or above (read at publish). floor.<set> overrides it for one measure.
What a measure's rounds count as a yes, and which sentences the types, pair checks and links ask about (in what is asked). Keep at or below every decision floor.
The evaluation suggests the floor with the most recall at this precision.
A type counts at this P(yes) or above.
Every type at floor.types (true) or the likeliest only.
on: re-propose OTH types from the sentences no approved type reaches; off: keep those already proposed.
Fewest such sentences before OTH types are proposed.
A sentence two measures both commit stays in a measure at this P(keep) or above.
Assets asked of each package: its best this many by cosine.
A package has an asset at this P(yes) or above.
Each committed sentence also paired with its project's nearest this many packages by the measure's phrases.
A further floor on the posterior for a sentence to count on the dashboards.
Where a commitment's asset may come from: unit, paragraph, none.
Only Investment Project Financing operations count.
A package is linked to a commitment at this P(yes) or above.
Another project prints a sentence near-identically when its committed sentences hold this share of its word runs.
Words per run when comparing wording (template_share and the dashboards' near-copy test).
Drop a sentence from a measure its pair check says it is not.
